attributes.title: 2027 ANNA National Symposium
attributes.summary:
The 2027 ANNA National Symposium for nephrology nurses is held April 18 to 21, 2027, at the Rosen Shingle Creek Hotel in Orlando, Florida. ANNA runs it as a hybrid meeting, so sessions can also be followed by livestream.

The event listing gives April 18 to 21, while the poster call on the same page says April 17 to 21, which may reflect pre-symposium activities. ANNA lists 17.0 ANCC contact hours for the symposium, and full registrants can redeem up to 17.0 more for on-demand sessions. Early-bird rates end February 1, 2027, and in-person pre-registration closes April 5; fee amounts were not shown on the pages we checked, though ANNA says members save $125. The hotel rate is $249 per night until March 22, 2027, and ANNA asks attendees to book rooms only through its own reservation link.
